warnings: Source coverage is separate from structural validation. A sample needs at least three returns within 0.75 m and a 15th-percentile height within 0.3 m. Missing/occluded returns and another ground level can reduce support. Even full support does not certify road semantics, survey accuracy, obstacles or traffic rules.

Source coverage is separate from structural validation. A sample needs at least three returns within 0.75 m and a 15th-percentile height within 0.3 m. Missing/occluded returns and another ground level can reduce support. Even full support does not certify road semantics, survey accuracy, obstacles or traffic rules.

Alternative source evidence uses the lowest 0.15 m vertical layer within 0.75 m XY with three occupied 0.2 m cells and a triangle area of at least 0.01 m². It uses the median of cell-low returns. A lower physical level can still win; compare the legacy quantile audit and investigate disagreement. This does not establish road semantics, accuracy, obstacles or traffic rules.

investigations: Compare trace Z with nearby low returns and inspect XY/ground-level alignment; a height mismatch does not establish that a Z-only correction is appropriate.

diagnosis.counting_note: Totals count oriented samples per lane/trace; a shared boundary can be checked for both lanes. They are not unique points or percentages of road length.
